name: footer-minimal
title: Minimal footer
author: Lambda Curry <https://github.com/lambda-curry>
description: One quiet line: copyright, a short note such as an address or hours, a few links and an optional credit.

meta.useWhen: The site is small, and the footer only needs to answer where, when and who.
meta.avoidWhen: The site has many pages that visitors look for at the bottom. Use footer-columns.

docs: Import from src/components/blocks/FooterMinimal.astro. In a Site Boulder site, render it from SiteFooter.astro and pass the existing credit link.
